retired.question: Every ability of Nobara Kugisaki
retired.reason: Not declared as a roster. The `Abilities and Powers` section mixes prose lead-ins (Overall Skill Level, the Maki training) with page-stated entries (the `Black Flash` entry under `Cursed Energy`, the three named techniques under `Cursed Technique`), so the roster's members=page-titles contract cannot be met across the whole section. The closed named-technique set is declared instead (`Every named cursed technique of Nobara Kugisaki`) and the rest is answered per-item via the qa questions in this section.
